title: Move to (V) shows a rule split but does not move to it
steps: On the fake data, in the Inbox press V on a conversation and type news
Press Return, then press the down arrow
Choose Add this sender to Newsletters, then press Cmd-Z
expected: Step 1: Newsletters is dimmed under Splits with This split is made by a rule, not a label; the cursor starts on Add this sender to Newsletters below it. Step 2: Return on the dimmed row does nothing and the arrow skips it. Step 3: the toast says the sender was added to Newsletters and Cmd-Z restores the rule. With Settings > General > Show splits and places in Move to off, V lists labels only.
